_meta.description: Cross-cutting parity: ConversationOrchestrator turn → JsonlWriter → read-back validates line format, field order, LF-only termination, and telemetry event linkage.

single_turn_sequence.why: claude-code 2.1.270 `lje(e)` (src_169588164.js) enables the static system-prompt snapshot unless CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE is set: `return e.systemPromptSnapshot === true || SESSION_KIND === 'bg' || REMOTE || !U2()`, and `function U2(){return a.CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE}` (src_167887003.js). With the env unset -- which is the default this fixture describes -- the snapshot is recorded, so a single turn is three lines, not two.

_meta.single_turn_sequence_provenance: Derived from the oracle's gate, not captured from a session. This fixture's other fields date to plan M5-14 / lingxi 0.6.0 and predate `prompt_snapshot` entirely; the original two-line sequence was the port's own early expectation, never an upstream recording, and it had been failing on main since the feature landed.
